info.name: Notification
info.description:
A scenario of the Notification service through the Gateway, with real User Management accounts and tokens. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: every request feeds the next.

Setup finds the active package in Registry and registers and logs in three fresh users. A notification is only ever created by consuming an event, and the contract exposes no route to inject one, so the Events folder makes real ones: friend requests sent through User Management are published as user.friend_request_created.v1, and the scenario waits for each to arrive.

Needs the shared stack with the broker, with User Management publishing and Notification consuming. Probes go straight to the service, because the Gateway routes only /v1/ paths.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script because Postman's {{$guid}} is v4 and the contract rejects it.
